header: Start with one till and your own articles
lead: The trial includes every feature. If you stay after 30 days, you don't have to set anything up again.
note: You create your account on the next page. After 30 days, each till costs €39 a month.

reassurances.title: No card
reassurances.text: The trial ends on its own. There's nothing to cancel, and it never turns into a paid plan by itself.

reassurances.title: 20 minutes to set up
reassurances.text: Import your articles, connect the printer and start selling. It only takes longer if you use scales.

reassurances.title: Your data stays yours
reassurances.text: If you stop, you export everything as CSV. We then delete the rest without you having to ask.
